description: Creates a Stripe checkout link for a new button. Nothing is charged by this call: the link must be opened and paid by the human buyer, and the button goes live only after a person at The Button Wall reviews it (full refund if rejected). Confirm size, position, plan, price, text and link with the user before calling. Call once per purchase: checkout links are rate-limited (10 per 10 minutes).

email.description: Buyer's email; receipts and the private manage link go here.
